Legal

Disclaimer

General information only. Not legal, tax, investment or agency advice. Rules change, city practice varies, and the only authoritative answer comes from the relevant authority in writing.

The short answer

Everything on this site is general information about how rules and processes generally work. It is not advice about your situation, it is not a recommendation of any property or professional, and it is not a substitute for a written answer from the authority that actually decides your file.

Not advice

Nothing here is legal, tax, financial or investment advice, and nothing here creates a professional relationship of any kind. The site describes how a process generally works in China; it cannot tell you how that process will treat your particular documents, your particular municipality or your particular marriage.

Where a decision has legal or tax consequences — ownership structures, inheritance, the repatriation of sale proceeds, the tax treatment of a specific transaction — consult a licensed professional in the relevant jurisdiction.

Accuracy and currency

Chinese property rules are set at national, municipal and sometimes district level, and they change with little notice. Figures on this site are indicative ranges with a stated date, not guarantees. Yields, prices and costs are compiled from public sources and are not appraisals.

Every page shows the date it was last reviewed. A page reviewed more than six months ago may no longer be accurate even though it is still published, and the site will say so where that is the case. If you find an error, please report it.

No recommendations

No agency, lawyer, bank, developer, lender or specific property is recommended, endorsed or vetted here. Where the site explains how to screen a professional, that is a method, not an introduction. Any commercial relationship you enter into is between you and that party alone.

No forecasts

The site does not predict prices, yields or returns, and any figure that looks like a projection is a calculator output based on assumptions you supply, not a view about the future.

Limitation of liability

The site is provided as-is, without warranty of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, no liability is accepted for any loss arising from reliance on its content, including decisions about whether to buy, what to buy, when to buy, or whom to engage.

External links

Links to other websites are provided for reference. Their content, accuracy and practices are their own responsibility, and following a link means you have left this site.

Governing note

This project is an independent editorial publication with no company, commercial activity or client relationship behind it. It does not act as an agent, broker, intermediary or adviser, and it does not handle, hold or transmit money in any form.

This page was last reviewed in March 2026.
